_comment: VTA ISA config for TRI-NET-G1 4x(2x2) PE-mesh — TT-Shuttle Squeeze v7 / S-51
description: TVM-VTA ISA for 4x(2x2) PE-mesh, ternary weight (2-bit), ternary input (2-bit)

pe_mesh.comment: 4 groups of 2x2 PE tiles; dataflow weight-stationary or DDR-streaming

data_types.comment: 2-bit ternary: encoding w in {-1,0,+1} as (sign,valid) per S-52 2-hot scheme

memory.comment: Sizes in 16-bit words; wgt_buff 4-banked for streaming (S-7)

comment_mac: 16 PEs x 1 ternary-MAC each; ternary XNOR-popcount path per S-47/S-52

dataflow_modes.name: weight-stationary
dataflow_modes.description: Weights preloaded into wgt_buff; activations stream DDR→inp_buff; S-1 mode

dataflow_modes.name: ddr-streaming
dataflow_modes.description: Both weights and activations streamed from DDR tile-by-tile; S-7 mode

opcodes.name: LOAD
opcodes.description: DMA load tile from DRAM to local buffer

opcodes.name: STORE
opcodes.description: DMA store tile from acc_buff to DRAM

schedule_knobs.comment: Search space for AutoTVM knobs in autotune_S51.py

autotvm.comment: AutoTVM search config per S-51; seed pinned for DREAMPlace consistency

stability.comment: ISA-stability ICA: if isa_version changes and hash differs, CI requires --reload-cache
